title: Perplexity's 'teammates' are the company's AI agents for daily work tasks

claims.claim: Perplexity, "teammates" adı verilen kişisel yapay zeka ajanlarını piyasaya sürdü.

evidence.quote: Perplexity has launched its personal AI agents called "teammates,"
Perplexity has launched its personal AI agents called "teammates," which are designed to be able to tackle ongoing work autonomously with minimal supervision.

claims.claim: "Teammates" özelliği yalnızca ayda 200 dolar veya yılda 2.000 dolar ödeyen Perplexity Max abonelerine özeldir.

evidence.quote: They're exclusively available to Perplexity Max subscribers paying $200 a month.
That makes it a pretty expensive proposition, as the subscription plan costs $200 a month or $2,000 a year.

At the moment, the feature is exclusively available to Perplexity Max subscribers on the web and on iOS. That makes it a pretty expensive proposition, as the subscription plan costs $200 a month or $2,000 a year.

claims.claim: Perplexity Max aboneliği web ve iOS üzerinde kullanılabilmektedir.

evidence.quote: At the moment, the feature is exclusively available to Perplexity Max subscribers on the web and on iOS.

claims.claim: Ajanlar, Perplexity Computer adlı bulut tabanlı asistan içinde çalışmaktadır.

evidence.quote: The agents work inside Perplexity Computer, the company's cloud-based agentic assistant that can perform multi-step tasks for you.

claims.claim: Teammates ajanları arka planda 7 gün 24 saat çalışabilmektedir.

evidence.quote: Teammates work 24/7 in the background and will notify you when you have to make decisions.
